class.name: IfcBuildingElementPartType
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: The building element part type defines lists of commonly shared property set definitions and representation maps of parts of a building element. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 2x4
class.description: Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files.

members.member: Subtype of building element part A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
